finding.summary: GitHub's repository workflow-runs endpoint supports head_sha filtering, a maximum per_page of 100, Link-based pagination, and a 1,000-result ceiling when search parameters such as head_sha are used. A retained result cannot support exhaustive-coverage claims unless request identity, page order, Link-chain termination, per-page payload integrity, exact-commit membership, and the provider ceiling are checked together.
finding.uncertainty: GitHub may introduce newer API versions; the validator records but does not independently prove transport headers or authentication identity.

fail_closed_conditions: more than 100 records in a page

verification.scope: deterministic local tests against exact source prior to repository write

falsification_route: Construct a retained pagination envelope with a broken intermediate Link chain and show that the validator accepts it.
Construct a page whose payload differs from its recorded SHA-256 digest and show that the validator accepts it.
Supply 1,000 exact-commit records and show that the validator promotes the result as exhaustive.
Execute both authenticated enumerators for one exact commit and compare the accepted run set against the raw retained pages.
design_implication: Place this gate before R-021 reconciliation. Only pagination_provenance_verified envelopes may enter the independent-enumeration comparison; provider-ceiling ambiguity remains non-promotable.
